Bengal Police Kill Rape-Murder Accused in Raiganj Gunfight

A man accused of rape and murder was killed in a gunfight with police in Raiganj, West Bengal. The accused was wanted in connection with the rape and murder of a 12-year-old. This incident marks the fourth encounter killing by Bengal Police in the last four months.
